name: twa-release-check
title_zh: 发版前先跑一遍的闸门顺序检查单
tagline_zh: CHANGELOG 怎么写、版本号怎么定、tag 怎么打，它按顺序一步步带你走完。
tagline_en: Walks you through CHANGELOG, versioning, tagging, standalone build, and post-release verification in the right.
desc_en: twa-edu-harness 發版前載入。涵蓋閘門執行順序、CHANGELOG 撰寫、 版本號決定、獨立版建置、tag 與 release 流程，以及發版後的驗證。
why_zh: 把散落在文档里的发版流程固化成可执行顺序，每一步都告诉你现在该做什么，不靠记忆不靠猜。
why_en: Turns scattered release docs into a fixed, executable sequence. Each step tells you what to do now, so nothing depends on memory.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 twa-edu-harness 这一仓库的发版流程；其他项目需自行改写。不含自动建置，只给步骤指引与检查。
limit_en: Only for twa-edu-harness repo. No auto-build; just step-by-step guidance and checks. Other projects need rewriting.
title_en: Pre-release gate sequence checklist for twa-edu-harness
